effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Among them, add 1 card with the [DM] trait to the hand and place 1 card with the [Ver.2] trait face down as the bottom digivolution card of any of your Digimon with the [DM] trait . Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
